reviewer_provenance: Codex AI-assisted single-pass visual inspection; no independent human adjudication of this new pass
review_basis: Paired 640 x 360 unboxed source and raw-ID detector panels were inspected in frame order across all 47 three-frame contact sheets. A candidate is sequence-consistent when its box follows the expected near-side UCLA player through neighbouring source frames. This is a visual continuity verdict, not an independently legible jersey-digit verdict at each frame or a floor-contact verdict.
known_limits: A visible sequence-consistent candidate is not a source-reviewed grounded court position.
Jersey digits are not independently readable in every source panel; roster identity is assessed by continuity across adjacent frames.
The late raw ID 78 association with UCLA #7 and exclusion of far-side raw ID 39 rely on the separately documented source correction.
Missing candidates retain null court coordinates and their separate targeted gap-source verdicts.
Serve-contact and point-ending boundaries remain bracketed rather than exact.
